falsification_tests.proposition_tested: Treat manifest images1and2as opposite sides; read IIandkfrom their ordinal order.
falsification_tests.result: Ordinal-only opposite-side assignment is not justified. Images1/2show complementary portions of a similar large initial, compatible with continued partial views, without a registered overlap. A two-stroke II/ij-like numeral is visible on image1and a k-like mark is now visible on image3, with different uppermost text/music. Images3/4were inspected but no literal seam/overlap was established.
falsification_tests.remaining_uncertainty: The one-leaf catalogue assigns1r:kand1v:II. These are source labels, not an independent determination of medieval side order. Under the Finnish Roman-recto/letter-verso scheme the inferred sides reverse those source labels; different catalogue conventions or book variation must be tested before any physical identity rejection.
falsification_tests.do_not_infer: No rejection of Codex1505membership or of the catalogue foliation labels.
